tasks.title: Part 1: Water
tasks.statement: Water is distributed over the entire surface and interior of the Earth, in oceans, seas, and the atmosphere, but also in rocks and minerals. Water circulates through the Earth systems and causes various natural phenomena. Through its existence, life-forms and all forms of life are evolved and sustained. The Earth has become a warm and dynamic habitable place. In addition, water is extremely different from those in the essential bodies of the Solar System. In essence, as Earth, especially in a solid: ice. In this part, we test knowledge and inference about the existence of water on Earth and the Solar System and their interactions within the geosphere, atmosphere, hydrosphere and biosphere.
